responsibility: Implements the rs6000 backend’s stack-frame, prologue, and epilogue machinery. It computes which GPR, FPR, and AltiVec registers must be saved, tracks frame layout in rs6000_stack_t, emits ABI-specific save/restore and TOC-handling sequences, supports special cases such as Darwin unwind save_world behavior and PIC state, and contains the target’s split-stack prologue and stack-space-check expansion, making it the file that owns low-level function entry/exit code generation rather than general call lowering.
